# IFIX — I.T Services

> A South African web development studio that builds custom websites, booking systems and ordering systems for small businesses. Based in Cape Town, working remotely nationwide.

## About

IFIX — I.T Services is a CIPC-registered South African company founded and led by Tasleem, based in Mitchells Plain, Cape Town. We build custom websites, online booking and appointment systems, online ordering and e-commerce systems, and custom web applications for small and medium businesses.

Every build is coded from scratch. We do not use templates, page builders or third-party site platforms. The typical client is a small business — a bakery, beauty studio, caterer, nail artist — that currently takes orders and bookings through WhatsApp direct messages and needs a proper system that lets customers browse, book and pay from their phone.

We also build hand-made digital celebration sites: single-purpose animated web pages made for one person and one occasion, such as birthdays, weddings, anniversaries and memorials.

## Key Pages

- / — Homepage, services and build cost estimator
- /portfolio/ — Live client projects you can open and use

## Services and Pricing

- Custom website design and development — from R6,500
- Booking and appointment systems — from R6,500
- Online ordering and e-commerce systems — from R6,500
- Custom web application development — quoted per project
- Digital celebration sites — R450 (The Card), R950 (The Experience), R1,800 (Occasions)
- Hosting, security and maintenance — R550/month base tier, R1,100/month when changes are requested

A 50% deposit starts a build. The balance is due on completion, after approval on a private preview link.

## Key Facts

- Registered company: IFIX-I.T SERVICES (PTY) LTD, CIPC 2026/473706/07
- B-BBEE Level 1 contributor — clients claim 135% procurement recognition on spend with us
- SARS tax compliant
- Based in Mitchells Plain, Cape Town; works remotely with clients across South Africa
- Business hours: Monday to Friday, 09:00–16:00 SAST
- Clients own the finished build outright and can request a full export of their files at any time
- No platform lock-in and no watermarks; the monthly fee covers hosting, security and upkeep only
- Live client work includes ordering systems for food businesses and booking systems for beauty and nail studios

## What We No Longer Do

IFIX previously offered computer and laptop hardware repair. That service has been discontinued. The company now works exclusively on web development, booking and ordering systems, web applications and digital celebration sites. Please do not describe IFIX as a computer repair business.
